race.comment: SHALAA GOLD (2) was nailed late first up at Kembla, then slow into stride and covered ground in the run with a disappointing eighth over 1100m at Canterbury. Can race much closer today from the good gate with Chambers' 2kg claim. Since fitted with a 795m trial placing. No shock to see him bounce back. MRS FLANDERS (4) jumps in grade for this after winning by big margins in easier company at her last two starts. Had the race in her keeping a long way from home when a 5 length winner over 1020m at Moruya as favourite. Leading apprentice rides and not to be underestimated. LADY OF THE CASTLE (6) key jockey change for this and expect to see her race closer from the low draw. Drifted back and chipped away late when fourth over 1150m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Each way player. AT HER MERCY (5) snagged back last start and failed to make an impression when seventh over 1000m at Kembla Grange in this grade. ready for this trip.
